root_cause: The Kernel release-input gate rejected Dockerfile.kernel because commit 8da25cfd added requirements/http-client.txt to the optional OIDC image without refreshing config/kernel/release-input-lock.json.

repair.notes: The OIDC dependency manifests are now explicit release inputs alongside the Dockerfile that installs them. No dependency versions or runtime images were changed in this repair.

release_input_gate.notes: Validated the locked inputs; no OCI archives were supplied, so image inventories were not inspected.

scope_limits: The hosted CI failure is not considered resolved until checks pass on a subsequent pushed head.
This repairs input-hash drift; it does not build or inspect an OCI image.
